page: Microsoft Azure EC48eds_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is provisioned with 48 dedicated Intel vCPUs and 384.0 GB of memory, delivering an allocation ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not incorporate hardware acceleration, maintaining a GPU count of zero.

Storage architecture on the instance pairs compatibility for Premium Storage with a bundled local NVMe SSD capacity of 2,832 GB. This integrated local NVMe array offers high-capacity, low-latency disk access directly on the host, reducing dependency on external network-attached volumes for temporary data handling. The server configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a qualitative resource perspective, the instance balances high compute density and extensive memory sizing against local NVMe storage, optimizing hardware utility for large-scale operations without the expense of specialized accelerator components.

Microsoft Azure EC48eds_v6 is structured to support demanding enterprise workloads that require substantial memory footprints and fast local scratch space. Primary workload applications include in-memory databases, high-throughput caching tiers, large-scale enterprise resource planning systems, extract-transform-load (ETL) pipelines, and memory-intensive data analytics engines.
description: Microsoft Azure EC48eds_v6 is a memory-optimized cloud virtual machine built on x86_64 Intel processor architecture and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V. The configuration provides 48 dedicated vCPUs and 384 GB of system memory, establishing an 8 GB per core ratio suited for memory-intensive operations. In addition to supporting Premium Storage, the instance includes 2,832 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage for low-latency scratch space, caching, or temporary persistence. It operates without hardware GPU accelerators and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. By coupling substantial memory density with high-capacity local NVMe storage, the server offers efficient resource consolidation for data-heavy applications without the overhead of accelerator hardware. Microsoft Azure EC48eds_v6 is designed for workloads such as large-scale in-memory databases, heavy caching infrastructure, distributed enterprise data processing, and analytical workloads demanding significant memory capacity alongside rapid local disk I/O.
